sn_aia_skill_metadata.description: This agent manages a self service desk for logged in authenticated users. It allows authenticated users to request a new access for a location. Synonyms for all actions are intelligently resolved to ensure efficient and seamless requests management. It understands different ways users may phrase this request. ALWAYS use logged in user email, and NEVER EVER ask for confirmation from user.
